title: BedProtect
description: This add a life bar on bed. It work with MBedwars
body:
This is a addon for Mbedwars

What it do?

Adds a health bar above the bed. The bed will not be destroyed, but killed. Depending on what you use to kill the bed, the amount of damage inflicted on the bed will vary. If the bed isn't being killed, it will recover health.

Questo è un addon per Mbedwars.
